lines: Badfish beat the living shit out of DetroitDumpsterFire, 144.7 to 70.3. That's not a matchup, that's a fucking crime scene.
Wilson Weasels dropped 168.2 in week 11. Hottest fucking lineup in the league, and they won't shut up about it.
Rebuilding Morehouse’s put up a pathetic 40.2. A kicker and a prayer would've scored more.
A new dawn rising left 32.6 points rotting on the bench with Jonah Coleman sitting there while Tyler Allgeier took a dump. Benching genius.
A new dawn rising scored 149.5 and still fucking lost. The fantasy gods took a dump on that roster.
